introduction: This spec updates the night-shift fix pipeline's prompt-building functions to use afspec-rendered context (structured requirements, test specifications, and tasks sections) instead of ad-hoc flat markdown criteria, aligning the coder and reviewer prompts with the structured format used by the `code` command path.

glossary.AcceptanceCriterion: Dataclass representing a single acceptance criterion produced by the triage agent.
glossary.FixReviewResult: Dataclass representing the structured output of the reviewer agent, containing per-criterion verdicts.
glossary.InMemorySpec: Dataclass in `agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder` representing a fully constructed in-memory afspec specification.
glossary.TriageResult: Dataclass produced by the triage agent representing the structured output of issue triage, including acceptance criteria.
glossary._build_coder_prompt(): Function in `fix_pipeline.py` that constructs the system and task prompts sent to the night-shift coder agent.
glossary._build_reviewer_prompt(): Function in `fix_pipeline.py` that constructs the system and task prompts sent to the night-shift reviewer agent.
glossary._format_triage_comment(): Function in `fix_pipeline.py` that posts a human-readable triage report as a GitHub issue comment.
glossary._render_criteria_context(): Legacy function in `fix_pipeline.py` that produced a flat `## Acceptance Criteria from Triage` markdown block; retained as a fallback after this change.
glossary._render_criteria_section(): Helper in `fix_pipeline.py` that renders acceptance criteria with optional bold formatting; retained for use by `_format_triage_comment()`.
glossary.afspec: The structured specification format and associated library used by agentfox to represent requirements, test specifications, and tasks in a machine-readable form.
glossary.afspec Spec: The top-level object returned by `build_afspec_from_triage()`, representing the full in-memory specification.
glossary.build_afspec_from_triage(): Function from spec 01 (`agentfox.nightshift.spec_builder`) that constructs an in-memory afspec `Spec` from a `TriageResult`.
glossary.build_system_prompt(): Existing utility that builds the final system prompt string given a `context` keyword argument.
glossary.build_task_prompt(): Existing utility used by the code-path coder to build the task prompt, referencing the subtask list in context.
glossary.criterion_id: Field in the reviewer's verdict report identifying which acceptance criterion a verdict applies to.
glossary.fix_pipeline.py: Source file in `agentfox.nightshift` containing the night-shift fix pipeline orchestration logic.
glossary.issue body context: Markdown text extracted from the GitHub issue body, prepended to the spec sections in the combined context.
glossary.parse_fix_review_output: Function that parses the reviewer's JSON verdict report into a `FixReviewResult`.
glossary.prior_context: Prior attempt context prepended to the coder's task prompt on retry attempts.
glossary.render_inmemory_spec_sections(): Function from spec 01 that renders an in-memory afspec `Spec` into markdown sections (`## Requirements`, `## Test Specification`, `## Tasks`).
glossary.review_feedback: Reviewer feedback text injected into the coder's task prompt on retry attempts.
glossary.context: The assembled string of spec sections and memory facts passed to build_system_prompt().
glossary.bold=True: The keyword argument to _render_criteria_section() that enables bold formatting for GitHub comments.
glossary.evidence: The evidence field in a FixReviewVerdict describing what the reviewer observed.
glossary.verdict: The verdict field in a FixReviewVerdict (PASS or FAIL).

user_story.goal: build the coder's system prompt from afspec-rendered sections rather than ad-hoc criteria text
user_story.benefit: the coder agent receives the same structured prompt format as the code-command coder, improving consistency and reliability

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `build_afspec_from_triage()` to obtain an `afspec Spec`, then calls `render_inmemory_spec_sections()` to produce markdown sections, joins the `issue body context` with the rendered sections (issue body first), and passes the combined string to `build_system_prompt()` as the `context` argument
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a system prompt string containing the issue body followed by `## Requirements`, `## Test Specification`, and `## Tasks` sections

acceptance_criteria.action: includes a task prompt that contains the phrase "Refer to the tasks subtask list in the context above" to align with the `build_task_prompt()` phrasing used by the code path
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a task prompt string containing the required subtask list reference phrase

acceptance_criteria.action: appends the `review_feedback` text to the task prompt, preserving existing retry injection behavior
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a task prompt string with `review_feedback` appended after the base task instructions

acceptance_criteria.action: prepends the `prior_context` text to the task prompt, preserving existing prior-attempt context injection behavior
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a task prompt string with `prior_context` prepended before the base task instructions

edge_cases.action: logs a warning and falls back to `_render_criteria_context()` to produce the criteria context, then proceeds normally with prompt construction
edge_cases.return_contract: a system prompt string built from the ad-hoc criteria context (fallback behavior); no exception propagated to the caller
edge_cases.error_condition: `build_afspec_from_triage()` raises an exception due to malformed triage data

user_story.goal: build the reviewer's system prompt from the same afspec-rendered sections as the coder
user_story.benefit: the reviewer verifies the fix against the same structured requirements the coder used, ensuring consistent evaluation

acceptance_criteria.action: uses the same `build_afspec_from_triage()` and `render_inmemory_spec_sections()` pipeline to produce the context, and passes the combined `issue body context` plus rendered sections to `build_system_prompt()`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a system prompt string containing the issue body followed by the afspec-rendered `## Requirements`, `## Test Specification`, and `## Tasks` sections

acceptance_criteria.action: includes a task prompt that instructs the reviewer to verify each acceptance criterion against the structured requirements rendered in the context
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a task prompt string containing instructions to verify each acceptance criterion

acceptance_criteria.action: produces a task prompt containing the fallback message: "No acceptance criteria were produced by triage. Verify the fix based on the issue description above."
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a task prompt string with the exact fallback message for empty triage
acceptance_criteria.state: the `TriageResult` contains no acceptance criteria (empty triage)

edge_cases.action: logs a warning and falls back to `_render_criteria_context()` for context construction, then proceeds normally with reviewer prompt construction
edge_cases.return_contract: a system prompt string built from the ad-hoc criteria context (fallback behavior); no exception propagated to the caller
edge_cases.error_condition: `build_afspec_from_triage()` raises an exception due to malformed triage data

requirements.title: Dead code removal: _render_criteria_context() retained as fallback only

user_story.goal: have `_render_criteria_context()` clearly marked as a fallback rather than a primary code path
user_story.benefit: the codebase communicates intent clearly, making it obvious the ad-hoc renderer is only for resilience and not the happy path

acceptance_criteria.action: retains `_render_criteria_context()` as a private function marked with a code comment indicating it is a fallback only, and does not call it on the happy path
retains `_render_criteria_section()` because `_format_triage_comment()` still requires it for bold-formatted GitHub triage comments

user_story.goal: continue to receive a human-readable triage report as a GitHub issue comment in the existing bold-formatted layout
user_story.benefit: the triage comment remains easy to read without being converted to machine-oriented afspec markdown

acceptance_criteria.action: continues to call `_render_criteria_section()` with `bold=True` and produces the same human-readable GitHub comment format as before this change; afspec rendering is not applied
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a GitHub comment string formatted with bold criteria headings, identical in structure to the pre-change output

user_story.goal: parse the reviewer's JSON verdict report using `parse_fix_review_output` without any changes to the verdict schema
user_story.benefit: downstream verdict parsing and handling logic requires no modification after the prompt alignment change

acceptance_criteria.action: produces and parses a JSON verdict report with the existing `criterion_id`, `verdict`, and `evidence` fields; the `FixReviewResult` dataclass and `parse_fix_review_output` function are not modified
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: a `FixReviewResult` with per-criterion verdicts using whatever `criterion_id` values appear in the afspec-rendered context

correctness_properties.title: Afspec context precedes ad-hoc context on the happy path
correctness_properties.invariant: `_render_criteria_context()` is NOT called; the context passed to `build_system_prompt()` is derived solely from `render_inmemory_spec_sections()`

correctness_properties.title: Issue body always precedes spec sections in combined context
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `_build_coder_prompt()` or `_build_reviewer_prompt()` that produces a combined context string
correctness_properties.invariant: the `issue body context` appears before the afspec-rendered (or fallback) sections in the string passed to `build_system_prompt()`

correctness_properties.title: Retry injections always preserved
correctness_properties.invariant: `review_feedback` appears appended to the task prompt and `prior_context` appears prepended to the task prompt, regardless of whether the afspec or fallback path was taken

correctness_properties.title: Triage comment rendering is independent of prompt rendering
correctness_properties.for_any: any execution of the fix pipeline
correctness_properties.invariant: `_format_triage_comment()` always calls `_render_criteria_section()` with `bold=True` and never calls `render_inmemory_spec_sections()`

correctness_properties.title: Reviewer verdict schema never changes
correctness_properties.for_any: any execution of `parse_fix_review_output` after this change
correctness_properties.invariant: `FixReviewResult` fields (`criterion_id`, `verdict`, `evidence`) are unchanged; `parse_fix_review_output` accepts the reviewer's output without schema validation of `criterion_id` values

execution_paths.title: Happy path: coder prompt built with afspec context

steps.action: invokes `_build_coder_prompt()` with a `TriageResult` containing acceptance criteria
calls `build_afspec_from_triage()` with the spec and triage data, receiving an `afspec Spec`
calls `render_inmemory_spec_sections()` on the `afspec Spec`, receiving a markdown string with `## Requirements`, `## Test Specification`, and `## Tasks` sections
joins the `issue body context` (first) with the rendered sections and passes the combined string to `build_system_prompt(context=...)`
constructs a task prompt containing "Refer to the tasks subtask list in the context above" and returns both system and task prompt strings to the orchestrator
receives the structured coder prompts and dispatches the coder agent

execution_paths.title: Fallback path: afspec construction fails, coder uses ad-hoc criteria

steps.action: invokes `_build_coder_prompt()` with a `TriageResult` whose data is malformed
calls `build_afspec_from_triage()`, which raises an exception
catches the exception, logs a warning, and calls `_render_criteria_context()` to produce the fallback ad-hoc criteria markdown
passes the fallback criteria context to `build_system_prompt()` and returns the prompts to the orchestrator without raising
receives the fallback coder prompts and dispatches the coder agent as normal

execution_paths.title: Happy path: reviewer prompt built with afspec context

steps.action: invokes `_build_reviewer_prompt()` with a `TriageResult` containing acceptance criteria
calls `build_afspec_from_triage()` and `render_inmemory_spec_sections()` using the same pipeline as the coder prompt
joins the `issue body context` with the rendered sections and passes the combined context to `build_system_prompt()`
constructs a task prompt instructing the reviewer to verify each acceptance criterion and returns both prompts
dispatches the reviewer agent with the structured prompts; reviewer returns a JSON verdict report parsed by `parse_fix_review_output`

execution_paths.title: Empty triage: reviewer receives fallback message

steps.action: invokes `_build_reviewer_prompt()` with a `TriageResult` that has no acceptance criteria
detects that the `TriageResult` contains no acceptance criteria
constructs a task prompt containing the fallback message: "No acceptance criteria were produced by triage. Verify the fix based on the issue description above."
receives the reviewer prompts with the fallback task message and dispatches the reviewer agent

execution_paths.title: Triage comment posted to GitHub with unchanged format

steps.action: invokes `_format_triage_comment()` with a `TriageResult` to generate a GitHub comment
calls `_render_criteria_section()` with `bold=True` to produce bold-formatted acceptance criteria text
returns the human-readable comment string, which the orchestrator posts to the GitHub issue

error_handling.condition: `build_afspec_from_triage()` raises an exception (e.g. due to malformed or missing fields in `TriageResult`) when called from `_build_coder_prompt()`
error_handling.behavior: catch the exception, emit a warning-level log entry describing the failure, call `_render_criteria_context()` to generate the fallback ad-hoc criteria context, and continue prompt construction without propagating the exception

error_handling.condition: `build_afspec_from_triage()` raises an exception when called from `_build_reviewer_prompt()`
error_handling.behavior: catch the exception, emit a warning-level log entry, call `_render_criteria_context()` to generate the fallback ad-hoc criteria context, and continue reviewer prompt construction without propagating the exception
